app.name: TaskPilot
app.tagline: Lightweight project planning for product teams
app.description: TaskPilot keeps tasks, projects and people in one simple view so teams always know what is next. This is a fictional sample app bundled with AppLens.

personas.label: Team lead
personas.description: Plans the work and keeps projects on track.

personas.label: Team member
personas.description: Picks up tasks and gets them done.
goals: Keep status up to date without meetings

personas.label: Stakeholder
personas.description: Follows progress from outside the team.

Project.description: Larger goals that tasks roll up to.

Task.description: Units of work on the board.

features.title: Boards and lists
features.description: Drag tasks across a board or work from a focused list.

features.title: Sprint planning
features.description: Balance work against capacity before the sprint starts.

features.title: Project health
features.description: Every project shows its progress and risk at a glance.
highlights: On track, at risk or off track

features.title: My work
features.description: One list with everything assigned to you, sorted by what matters.

features.title: Read-only share links
features.description: Share progress with anyone, no account required.

scenarios.title: Plan a task through to done
scenarios.description: Follow one task across the whole board.

steps.narration: Capture a new task in the backlog.
Prioritise it and estimate the effort.
Open the next task in the todo column.
